info.title: Depthwatch API
info.summary: Read-only liquidity metrics for Uniswap v3/v4, Aerodrome and Aero pools on Base mainnet (chain id 8453).
info.description: Depthwatch measures executable liquidity: USD depth at ±1/2/5 % per side, round-trip effective spread at $1k/$10k/$100k (fees included), LP concentration, liquidity persistence over 24 h and 7 d, a 0–100 Liquidity Health Score and a liquidity gaps feed. Conventions: price is token1 per token0, decimal adjusted; the up side is buy pressure on token0 (input token1), the down side sell pressure (input token0); raw token amounts and block numbers are decimal strings; times are unix seconds; null means not known, never zero; USD prices are derived from the pools and are not an oracle. For the tokenized stocks of base.org/stocks it adds, per stock, depth, spread and venue shares, and each pool's deviation from the stock's Chainlink feed (GET /api/stocks); Chainlink's answer is passed on with its status and age, and Depthwatch publishes no stock price. Coinbase tokenized stocks are offered under Regulation S and are only available to persons in eligible jurisdictions outside of the U.S.; Depthwatch does not offer, route or recommend trades in them. Check GET /api/health first: source "demo" means synthetic data; snapshotAgeSeconds says how old the newest snapshot is, and ?maxAge=<seconds> makes it answer 503 when older. Responses are compressed when Accept-Encoding allows it and carry an ETag (304 on If-None-Match); GET /AGENTS.md "Caching" has the Cache-Control values. Errors are JSON { error, issues? }. This document lists every GET route; the operator-only write routes POST /api/mm and DELETE /api/mm/{id} (bearer DEPTHWATCH_ADMIN_TOKEN) are not described here. The full guide is GET /AGENTS.md; metric definitions are in docs/METRICS.md of the repository.

get.summary: Database counts, newest snapshot and its age, data source; a liveness probe with maxAge

parameters.name: maxAge
parameters.description: Seconds. When given, the server answers 503 (ok false, error "stale: …", counts still filled) when snapshotAgeSeconds is null or above this value, so a liveness probe fails on stale data; 2 x the pipeline's snapshot interval (3600 for the default 30 minutes) is a sensible value.

200.description: The database is readable and, when maxAge is given, the newest snapshot is at most maxAge seconds old.

503.description: The database cannot be read (ok is false, counts are 0, error is the database error), or maxAge was given and the newest snapshot is older than that or missing (ok is false, counts filled, error starts with "stale: ").

200.description: One row per DEX in the order uniswap-v3, uniswap-v4, aerodrome-v2, aerodrome-slipstream, aero-v2, aero-slipstream, plus the totals.

get.summary: Ranked, filtered page of scored pools

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A pasted pool id, <dex>:<0x hex> such as uniswap-v3:0xd0b5... (spaces around the : allowed, %3A for the : too, or the pool's whole link), lists the pools on that DEX whose address or Uniswap v4 pool id starts with that hex, in any case. Any other text is search terms split on spaces, /, -, : and commas, every one matching the pool, case-insensitively: anywhere in either token's symbol or address, the pool address or the Uniswap v4 pool id, or at the start of a word in either token's name. Terms never match the DEX (dex filters it). WETH/USDC and usdc weth list the same pools.

parameters.name: rated
parameters.description: true keeps only rated pools, false only unrated ones; both when absent.

200.description: Scored pools; null sort values last, ties by pool id ascending. Sorting by health puts unrated pools after the rated ones in both directions.

200.description: Plain text in the llms.txt convention.

PoolId.name: id
PoolId.description: Pool id as returned by the API: <dex>:<lowercase pool address>, or uniswap-v4:<poolId>. Matched exactly; the colon may be percent-encoded.

PoolSort.name: sort
PoolSort.description: health total, ±2 % depth, 24 h volume, gap score, TVL, spread10kBps (spread) or ownerTop1Share (top); null values sort last in both directions, unrated pools come after the rated ones when sorting by health, and stale quotes after the others when sorting by depth.

MinVolume.name: minVolume
MinVolume.description: Keep pools whose known 24 h volume is at least this many USD; pools with unknown volume are dropped.

BadRequest.description: Invalid query parameter (issues has one entry per parameter) or, on /api/tokens/{address} and /api/stocks/{token}, a malformed address.

NotFound.description: Unknown pool, token, stock or mandate (error is "pool not found", "token not found", "stock not found" or "mandate not found").

DataSource.description: demo: the synthetic demo world, never trade on it. live: the operator's Base mainnet database.

DecimalString.description: An integer too large for a JSON number (raw token amount, liquidity, block number).

NullableGrade.description: The letter; null for a pool that is not rated.

UnratedReason.description: Why a pool has no grade, null when it is rated, tested in this order: hooked (a pool with a swap hook Depthwatch does not model, PoolMeta.hooks: depth, spread and concentration are not computed), transfers-paused (a pool of a tokenized stock whose transfers are paused at the snapshot's block, so every swap in it reverts; its depth and spread are published as measured and left out of the depth sums), unpriced (a side has no USD price), one-sided (the deeper ±2 % side holds $5,000, the thinner does not) or thin (neither side does).

ConcentrationBasis.description: What the 20 concentration points stand on: owners (the largest owner's share, from indexed owners covering at least 90 % of the in-band liquidity), ranges (the range HHI of a concentrated pool: owners not indexed or covering less) or neutral (10 points: a reserve pool without owner data, or no data). null only for a score stored before the basis was recorded.

trackedCount.description: Pools the pipeline snapshots and scores.

latestSnapshotAt.description: Unix seconds of the newest snapshot.

latestScoredAt.description: Unix seconds of the newest score: a pass writes its snapshots first and its scores at its end, so data that read scores (health, gap, 24 h volume) are new once this moves. null before the first score.

snapshotAgeSeconds.description: The server's clock minus latestSnapshotAt; null before the first snapshot.

latestBlock.description: Block number of the newest snapshot.

rated.description: Scored pools that are rated: both ±2 % sides known and the thinner at least $5,000.

depth2Usd.description: Sum of ±2 % depth (USD) over scored pools, stale quotes (staleQuote) and pools unrated transfers-paused left out.

depthKnownPools.description: Scored pools with a known ±2 % depth, no stale quote and transfers not paused: the pools depth2Usd sums.

volume24hUsd.description: Sum of 24 h volume (USD) over scored pools with a known volume; null when none has one.

medianHealth.description: Median health total over rated pools only; null when none is rated.

depth2Usd.description: Sum of ±2 % depth (USD) over the DEX's scored pools, stale quotes (staleQuote) and pools unrated transfers-paused left out.

depthKnownPools.description: The DEX's scored pools with a known ±2 % depth, no stale quote and transfers not paused: the pools depth2Usd sums.

address.description: The token's identity. Symbols are not unique: Aerodrome's and Aero's AERO both answer AERO.

label.description: Display name: the symbol, unless another token of a scored pool shares it; then SYMBOL (name), or SYMBOL (0x3f5b…a4ee) when the name is shared too. Computed per response; it can change as pools are scored.

feePips.description: LP fee in millionths: 500 = 0.05 %, as last read: the latest snapshot's reading, or for a pool never snapshotted the reading at discovery. Slipstream pools (aerodrome-slipstream, aero-slipstream) have a dynamic fee that can change every block; latest.feePips is the fee the latest snapshot used. Uniswap v4 swaps (and so v4 depth and spread) also pay the slot0 protocol fee, which this value does not include.

stable.description: Aerodrome v2 or Aero v2 stable (x³y + xy³) pool.

hooks.description: Uniswap v4: the hooks address, 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 for every pool without a hook. Aero Slipstream: the pool's swap hook when it is not the reviewed one or charges each block's first swap an initial fee, else null. Null or the zero address means no hook; any other address makes the pool unrated with reason hooked.

price.description: token1 per token0, decimal adjusted, from the newest snapshot.

depth2Usd.description: ±2 % depth, up and down sides summed, USD (only the priced side when one token has no USD price).

depth2UpUsd.description: Buy side of the ±2 % depth: USD of token1 that lifts the price 2 %, the newest snapshot's depthUsd[pct = 2].upUsd. null when token1 has no USD price or the pool has no snapshot.

depth2DownUsd.description: Sell side of the ±2 % depth: USD of token0 that pushes the price down 2 %, the newest snapshot's depthUsd[pct = 2].downUsd. null when token0 has no USD price or the pool has no snapshot.

spread10kBps.description: Round-trip effective spread at $10,000, bps, fees included.

priceDeviationBps.description: The newest snapshot's priceDeviationBps: |price / (token0Usd / token1Usd) − 1| × 10,000. null when a token has no USD price or the pool has no snapshot (or one stored before the field existed).

staleQuote.description: True when priceDeviationBps is at least 500: the pool quotes a price 5 % or more away from the market's. Its depth is left out of the stats' depth sums and sorts last on depth.

ownerTop1Share.description: The largest owner's share of the newest snapshot's in-band liquidity, 0..1, where the indexed owners describe the pool: some hold liquidity in the band (concentration.owners.count > 0) and together they cover at least 90 % of it (concentration.owners.coverage ≥ 0.9). Null otherwise: owners not indexed, none in the band, or covering less (a lone unstaked LP beside a gauge holding most of a Slipstream pool would otherwise read 100 %).

updatedAt.description: Unix seconds of the newest snapshot.

total.description: Matching scored pools, ignoring limit and offset.

amountIn.description: Raw input amount, fee included (token1 for up, token0 for down).

amountOut.description: Raw output amount received on the way.

reached.description: False when the known tick range ended before the target price (or the pool cannot move); the amounts are then totals to that point. A stretch with no liquidity inside the known range is crossed at no cost, as it is onchain, so the target is reached.

totalUsd.description: upUsd + downUsd when both are known, else the known side, else null.

notionalUsd.description: 1000, 10000, 100000 or 1000000 (snapshots stored before the 1000000 point have the first three).

spreadBps.description: (buyAvgPrice − sellAvgPrice) / mid × 10 000; null when infeasible: a leg is incomplete or yields nothing, or its average price is more than 5,000 bps from mid. A feasible spread is at most 10,000.

top1Share.description: Out of the indexed owners' total in-band weight.

coverage.description: Σ owner weights / the pool's whole in-band weight: how much of the pool the indexed owners account for. A Slipstream gauge's staked positions count as uncovered. Null (unknown) in a snapshot stored before coverage was recorded.

bandPct.description: Half-width of the band around mid, percent (5).

owners.description: Null when positions were not indexed.

priceDeviationBps.description: |price / (token0Usd / token1Usd) − 1| × 10,000; a stale quote from 500. null when a token has no USD price, and in snapshots stored before the field existed.

feePips.description: The LP fee in millionths this snapshot's depth and spread used (Uniswap v4: the LP fee; the protocol fee is charged on top). A Slipstream pool's fee is read at the snapshot's block and can change from one block to the next. null in snapshots stored before schema version 7.

reference.description: A stock pool set against its stock's Chainlink reading at this snapshot's block (docs/METRICS.md, Reference deviation); null for a pool without a tokenized stock, and in snapshots stored before schema version 8.

ReferenceStatus.description: A stock's Chainlink reading at a snapshot block, the first that applies: no-feed (the stock list records no feed for the stock), unread (a required call, latestRoundData, decimals, description or the oracle registry's getOracleParams, failed, reverted or did not decode), paused (the oracle registry's paused flag: during a corporate action the feed holds its last good value), invalid (answer not positive, updatedAt 0 or after the block, decimals or description not the recorded feed's), held (the feed holds a closed market's value: its age is above its heartbeat plus 3,600 s, 90,000 s for the ten feeds, or the block lies in the weekly close, Friday 20:00 to Sunday 20:00 New York time, and the round is from before the close began), live (otherwise). Only a live reading is compared with a pool.

ReferenceNullReason.description: Why a stock pool has no deviation, null when it has one; the first that applies: hooked (a pool with a swap hook Depthwatch does not model), thin (the thinner ±2 % side is not known to hold $5,000), stock-pair (both tokens are stocks), the reading's status when it is not live (no-feed, unread, paused, invalid, held: no pool is compared with a value that is no market price) or quote-unpriced (the quote's USD price is routed through a pool of the stock itself).

PoolReference.description: A stock pool against its stock's reading at the snapshot's block. Not an oracle: referenceUsd is Chainlink's answer passed on with its status and age, poolUsd this one pool's mid in dollars; neither is a price to settle, mark or liquidate against, and Depthwatch publishes no stock price.

stock.description: The pool's stock token; token0's when both tokens are stocks (deviationNull stock-pair).

poolUsd.description: USD per stock token at the pool's mid, from the quote token's USD price only (the price graph's valuation convention); null when the pool is hooked, the quote has no USD price or the quote's price route runs through a pool of the stock.

referenceUsd.description: Chainlink's answer / 10^decimals, USD per stock token (the feeds answer per token: the token's multiplier is never applied); published for live, held and paused readings, null for the others.

feedAgeSeconds.description: Seconds from the feed's latest round (updatedAt) to the snapshot's block, both chain times; null without a feed, after a failed read, or when updatedAt is 0 or after the block. A live reading with a large age may be a quiet market or a weekday holiday.

deviationBps.description: (poolUsd / referenceUsd − 1) × 10,000, signed: positive when the pool prices the stock above the feed. Not rounded. null when deviationNull says why.

toleranceBps.description: The feed's deviation threshold (50 bps for the ten feeds) plus the pool's LP fee in bps at the snapshot's block: deviationThresholdBps + feeBps. null with the deviation, and when the fee is unknown.

deviationThresholdBps.description: The first part of toleranceBps: the feed's deviation threshold in bps (a feed publishes a round on a move this large while its market is open). null when toleranceBps is.

feeBps.description: The second part of toleranceBps: the pool's LP fee at the snapshot's block in bps (feePips / 100), which an arbitrage against the pool pays. null when toleranceBps is.

withinTolerance.description: |deviationBps| ≤ toleranceBps: no larger than the feed's band and the pool's fee explain, so no sign of mispricing; false: the pool and the feed's last round disagree by more. null when either is null.

transfersPaused.description: The stock's pausedFeatures() holds TRANSFER at the snapshot's block (either stock's in a pool of two): every swap in the pool reverts, its score is unrated (transfers-paused) and its depth is left out of the depth sums. null when pausedFeatures() failed: unknown is not a pause.

rated.description: Both ±2 % sides are known and the thinner holds at least $5,000.

stability.description: p10 / median, 0..1; 0 when the median is 0; null with fewer than 3 samples or samples spanning under 25 % of the window.

uptime.description: Share of samples ≥ half the median, 0..1; 0 when the median is 0; null under the same conditions as stability.

health.description: Health total recomputed for this snapshot.

feePips.description: The LP fee in millionths this snapshot's depth and spread used: a Slipstream pool's fee moves from block to block, and this explains a spread that moved with it. null in snapshots stored before schema version 7.

to.description: The pool's newest snapshot (the current time when it has none).

total.description: Pools in the feed at this floor, ignoring limit and offset.

meaningful.description: Pools in the feed trading 3× their ±2 % depth or more (turnoverRatio ≥ 3), ignoring limit and offset.

usd.description: Derived USD price; null when unreachable from the stable anchors.

via.description: Pool ids the price was derived through, plus `wrap:weth` for the native ETH ↔ WETH step and any other non-pool source (those are not pool ids: GET /api/pools/{id} returns 404 for them). Empty for an anchor stable or an unpriced token.

total.description: Scored pools containing the token, ignoring limit and offset.

poolCount.description: Every discovered pool containing the token.

depth2UsdTotal.description: ±2 % depth (depth2Usd) summed over every scored pool containing the token with a known depth, no stale quote (staleQuote) and not unrated transfers-paused, ignoring limit and offset; null when none has one.

depthKnownPools.description: Scored pools of the token whose depth2Usd is known, whose quote is not stale and whose transfers are not paused: the pools depth2UsdTotal sums.

PausableFeature.description: A B20 token's pausable features, by ordinal TRANSFER 0, MINT 1, BURN 2, SEIZE 3. Only transfer changes anything here: while it is paused every swap in the stock's pools reverts. Minting and redeeming are the issuer's flow, not the market's.

StockFeedInfo.description: A stock's Chainlink feed as the stock list records it.

address.description: The feed proxy, read with latestRoundData() at each snapshot block.

decimals.description: The feed's decimals (8 for the ten feeds); a feed answering other decimals reads invalid.

heartbeatSeconds.description: The feed's heartbeat while its market is open (86,400 s for the ten); none off-hours.

deviationThresholdBps.description: The move, in bps, that makes the feed publish a round while open (50 for the ten): the band of toleranceBps.

hours.description: 24/5: US equity sessions, the feed held through the weekly close (Friday 20:00 to Sunday 20:00 New York time); 24/7: no weekly close.

StockReading.description: A stock's Chainlink reading at a snapshot block (docs/METRICS.md, Reference deviation), with the token's own multiplier and paused features. Not an oracle: referenceUsd is Chainlink's answer passed on with its status and age; it is not a price to settle, mark or liquidate against.

blockNumber.description: The snapshot block the reading was taken at.

referenceUsd.description: Chainlink's answer / 10^decimals, USD per stock token (the feeds answer per token: the token's multiplier is never applied); published for live, held and paused readings, null for the others.

feedAgeSeconds.description: timestamp − feedUpdatedAt, both chain times; null without a feed, after a failed required call, or when updatedAt is 0 or after the block. A live reading with a large age may be a quiet market or a weekday holiday.

feedRoundId.description: latestRoundData()'s roundId; null when the call failed.

feedAnswer.description: latestRoundData()'s answer, raw (the feed's decimals); null when the call failed.

feedUpdatedAt.description: latestRoundData()'s updatedAt, unix seconds; null when the call failed.

oracleMultiplierWad.description: The multiplier Coinbase's oracle registry answers for the stock (getOracleParams), shares per token in WAD (10^18 = 1); null when the call failed, reverted or did not decode.

oraclePaused.description: The oracle registry's paused flag: during a corporate action the feed holds its last good value (referenceStatus paused). Not a token pause. null when the call failed.

tokenMultiplierWad.description: The token's own multiplier(), shares per token in WAD (1000538000000000000: one token is 1.000538 shares); never applied to the answer. null when the call failed.

pausedFeatures.description: pausedFeatures() decoded, in ordinal order; empty when nothing is paused, null when the call failed.

transfersPaused.description: pausedFeatures holds transfer: every swap in every pool of the stock reverts, so none of them counts in the depth sums. null when pausedFeatures() failed: unknown is not a pause.

error.description: The failed calls ("<call>: <reason>", "; "-joined), or why the reading is invalid; null otherwise.

StockDeviationNull.description: Why a stock has no deviation, null when it has one: its deepest pool's deviationNull (ReferenceNullReason), unread when that pool's newest snapshot carries no reference (one stored before schema version 8), or no-pool when no pool is in the depth sums (none has both sides known, every quote is stale, or the stock's transfers are paused).

StockVenue.description: A stock's pools on one DEX. Shares are 0..1.

poolCount.description: The stock's pools on this DEX.

depth2Usd.description: Σ (buy + sell) ±2 % over the venue's pools in the depth sums; null when none is.

depthShare.description: depth2Usd / (depth2BuyUsd + depth2SellUsd); null when depth2Usd is null or the total is 0.

volume24hUsd.description: Σ of the venue's known 24 h volumes, counted pools or not; null when none is known.

volumeShare.description: volume24hUsd / the stock's volume24hUsd; null when the venue's volume is unknown or the total is 0.

StockSummary.description: One tokenized stock across every scored pool of it (docs/METRICS.md, Stock aggregates), with its newest reading. A pool counts in the depth sums, the spread and the deepest-pool choice when its quote is not stale and the stock's transfers are not paused; TVL and volume take every pool. A stock's usd on GET /api/tokens/{address}, and a snapshot's token0Usd or token1Usd, are the price graph's valuation convention for depth and TVL, not a stock price; Depthwatch publishes none.

token.description: The stock token. Match it by address, never by symbol or label: a token's metadata is mutable onchain.

ticker.description: The ticker of the feed's description, "Coinbase <ticker>" (NVDA for NVDAc).

feed.description: The stock's Chainlink feed; null when the stock list records none (referenceStatus no-feed).

reading.description: The stock's newest stored reading; null before the first one.

tvlUsd.description: Σ tvlUsd of the pools whose TVL is known (tvlKnownPools), counted or not; a lower bound while a Uniswap v4 pool's is unknown; null when none is known.

depth2BuyUsd.description: Σ of the stock's ±2 % buy sides (the quote as input: depth2UpUsd where the stock is token0, depth2DownUsd where it is token1) over the counted pools with both sides known (sidesKnownPools); null when there is none.

depth2SellUsd.description: Σ of the stock's ±2 % sell sides (the stock as input) over the same pools as depth2BuyUsd; null when there is none.

sidesKnownPools.description: The counted pools with both sides known: the pools depth2BuyUsd and depth2SellUsd sum. A pool counts when its quote is not stale and the stock's transfers are not paused.

spread10kBps.description: The lowest feasible $10k round-trip spread among the counted pools; null when none is feasible.

spread10kPoolId.description: The pool of spread10kBps, ties to the lower pool id.

volume24hUsd.description: Σ 24 h volume of the pools whose volume is known (volumeKnownPools), counted or not: it is what traded; null when none is.

venues.description: One row per DEX holding a pool of the stock, in the fixed DEX order.

deepestPoolId.description: Among the pools in the depth sums, the one with the largest thinner side (ties: the larger total, then the lower pool id); null when there is none.

deviationBps.description: The deepest pool's deviationBps from Chainlink's answer (PoolReference); null when deviationNull says why. A deviation, not a stock price.

withinTolerance.description: The deepest pool's withinTolerance: true means the deviation is no larger than the feed's 0.5 % band plus the pool's fee explain, no sign of mispricing.

updatedAt.description: When the stock list was last written: the block time of the newest snapshot pass.

items.description: Every stock of the stock list, by depth2BuyUsd + depth2SellUsd descending (unknown last), then ticker.

StockPoolRow.description: One scored pool of a stock, oriented to the stock.

stockIs.description: Which of the pool's tokens is the stock.

depth2BuyUsd.description: The pool's ±2 % side whose input is the quote, buying the stock: depth2UpUsd when the stock is token0, depth2DownUsd when it is token1.

depth2SellUsd.description: The other ±2 % side: the stock as input.

counted.description: The pool counts in the stock's spread and, with both sides known, in its depth sums and deepest-pool choice: its quote is not stale, and the stock's transfers are paused neither at the pool's snapshot (reference.transfersPaused) nor at a newer reading of the stock (either stock's, in a pool of two).

reference.description: The newest snapshot's reference, as latest.reference on GET /api/pools/{id}; null for a snapshot stored before schema version 8.

token.description: The stock token. Match it by address, never by symbol or label: a token's metadata is mutable onchain.

ticker.description: The ticker of the feed's description, "Coinbase <ticker>" (NVDA for NVDAc).

feed.description: The stock's Chainlink feed; null when the stock list records none (referenceStatus no-feed).

reading.description: The stock's newest stored reading; null before the first one.

tvlUsd.description: Σ tvlUsd of the pools whose TVL is known (tvlKnownPools), counted or not; a lower bound while a Uniswap v4 pool's is unknown; null when none is known.

depth2BuyUsd.description: Σ of the stock's ±2 % buy sides (the quote as input: depth2UpUsd where the stock is token0, depth2DownUsd where it is token1) over the counted pools with both sides known (sidesKnownPools); null when there is none.

depth2SellUsd.description: Σ of the stock's ±2 % sell sides (the stock as input) over the same pools as depth2BuyUsd; null when there is none.

sidesKnownPools.description: The counted pools with both sides known: the pools depth2BuyUsd and depth2SellUsd sum. A pool counts when its quote is not stale and the stock's transfers are not paused.

spread10kBps.description: The lowest feasible $10k round-trip spread among the counted pools; null when none is feasible.

spread10kPoolId.description: The pool of spread10kBps, ties to the lower pool id.

volume24hUsd.description: Σ 24 h volume of the pools whose volume is known (volumeKnownPools), counted or not: it is what traded; null when none is.

venues.description: One row per DEX holding a pool of the stock, in the fixed DEX order.

deepestPoolId.description: Among the pools in the depth sums, the one with the largest thinner side (ties: the larger total, then the lower pool id); null when there is none.

deviationBps.description: The deepest pool's deviationBps from Chainlink's answer (PoolReference); null when deviationNull says why. A deviation, not a stock price.

withinTolerance.description: The deepest pool's withinTolerance: true means the deviation is no larger than the feed's 0.5 % band plus the pool's fee explain, no sign of mispricing.

updatedAt.description: When the stock list was last written: the block time of the newest snapshot pass.

pools.description: Every scored pool of the stock: the counted pools first, then the larger thinner ±2 % side (unknown last), then the pool id.

minDepthUsd.description: USD depth required on each side at ±bandPct.

poolId.description: The mandate's pool, lowercase: <dex>:<pool address>, or uniswap-v4:<poolId>. Registration accepts any case and stores it lowercase.

alertWebhookConfigured.description: True when an alert webhook is set. The webhook URL itself is a secret and is never returned by any route.

depthUpUsd.description: The market maker's own depth, USD.

poolDepthUpUsd.description: The whole pool's depth at the same band.

withinKpi.description: Null when not evaluable (a USD price was missing).
